title: Call the function

blocks.md:
## A name is not a call

`ping` is the function. `ping()` runs it and gives you `"pong"`. Printing the function itself is not the same as printing its result.

The last line, `module.exports = { ping }`, is how the checker reaches your function. Leave it there and ignore it for now — it is harness plumbing, not syntax you need yet. Modules get taught properly in the Node track.

choices.md: The function text — you never called it

blocks.promptMd: > Call `ping` and print the returned string `pong`.

hintLadder.md: The file prints a question mark. Nothing has called `ping` yet.
Parentheses run the function: `ping()`. Without them you are holding the function itself.

description: Name a function and pass values in to run it. Nothing runs until you call it.
